name: Eugene Country Club
architects: H. Chandler Egan (1923-27); Robert Trent Jones Sr. (1967 redesign, the routing reversed so the old greens became tees)

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth; newest project at the course OLC_WILLAMETTE_VALLEY_2023_SOUTH, also OLC_LANE_COUNTY_2014), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 492300-493700 / y 4878500-4880000, fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-eugene_cc)

chm.source: DOGAMI lidar CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC (highest hit minus bare earth), same box and date
chm.label: DOGAMI canopy height model

scorecard_source: Third-party (no card on the club's site found): GolfPass (course 11296) per-hole par, men's handicap and yardages for every tee set, read 2026-11-13; the Championship row adds up to 7,015 yd. Championship rating/slope 74.6/140 from stymie.golf, which prints that tee as 7,030 yd. Unverified against a printed card.
attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
Orthophoto (checks only): Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-11-13: the longest tee set (Championship) and it is the default; all water red; OB = the OSM course boundary, roads inside it are cart paths, the driving range is OB; inland Pacific Northwest wind 1-7 mph; trees from DOGAMI lidar, trees in fairways or in the way of a centre-line drive removed and listed. Theme eugene_cc (new; the course chat's design).

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (763 x 934 m, way/124953002) + at least 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (130 m west/east, 173 m south/north)
